mechanism.base: Water is what metal becomes when it stops holding its shape. In the old texts the cold blade gathers dew out of the morning air, and metal melted in enough heat runs like a river, so the child of steel is the stream. What the edge kept hard and silent, the water carries off and says. A spring under a mountain is the ore learning to move.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Water, the blade stays dry: everything you sharpen is kept inside, and nobody gets the use of it. Show one unfinished thing to one person before it is ready.

catalyst.clause: The blade stays dry: everything you sharpen is kept inside, and nobody gets the use of it.
catalyst.remedy: Show one unfinished thing to one person before it is ready.

function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is what pours out of you and feeds someone. The wish to feed has you cooking and telling the story, never the one fed, while the wish to shine puts the sharpest line in the show and pays in the people it cut.
function.advise_catalyst: Keeping it in feels like control, and mostly it is pressure with the lid on. Write a page most mornings and send one a week to somebody who answers. Cook for people once a month and let them watch. Say one thing at the table that you would usually only think. Hum while you do the dishes.

candidates.cta_verdict: What you say or make comes out with a clean edge already on it, and it gets quoted back to you later more often than you expect.

mechanism.base: In the old reckoning water is metal's child: cold iron beads the morning dew, and metal, melted, runs bright as any river. The hard thing does not stay hard. At its finest edge it turns liquid, and what was fixed begins to flow, the clear stream carrying the mountain's sharpness out into the world.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, this channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said. That is why your chart asks you to feed it. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.

catalyst.clause: This channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said.
catalyst.remedy: Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.

function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the bright remark that turns an evening: whatever is inside you moves outward without forcing, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry.
function.advise_catalyst: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it to done, not to pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Comfort that never risks anything eventually feeds no one.

$original.cta_verdict: Your precision leaves you as flow, and the things you finally say arrive so smooth nobody sees how long you sharpened them.
